title: Wiki: Core Loop
summary: Open the article, follow related links, then return to play with one clear answer.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Search or filter, open an article, follow related records, and use guide books as stable module-specific entry points.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each article, decide whether it answered a block, item, route, mechanic, or troubleshooting question. If not, follow one related link and stop.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop reading when you have the next move. The best manual page gets you back into the world with fewer guesses.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
